name: @skastr0/prism-workspace

scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run build
scripts.pack:npm-cli:dry-run: npm pack --dry-run --workspace packages/npm/prism-darwin-arm64 --workspace packages/npm/prism-darwin-x64 --workspace packages/npm/prism-linux-arm64 --workspace packages/npm/prism-linux-x64 --workspace packages/npm/prism
